facts.claim: the active substance came out of solution near ninety percent while most contaminating protein stayed behind
facts.problem: Confidence LOW that anything is wrong; this is a wording note, not an error. Collip found the active principle precipitated when alcohol was raised to just over 90 percent while the contaminants remained dissolved. Read as 'stayed behind in solution' the sentence is right; a student could read 'stayed behind' as 'stayed in the precipitate', which inverts the mechanism. Consider 'stayed in solution'.

facts.claim: preparing a lecture on the pancreas
facts.problem: Confidence LOW; a simplification rather than an error. Banting was preparing a lecture on carbohydrate metabolism for Western's medical students; the pancreas was the topic within it. Most popular accounts say 'on the pancreas', so this is defensible as written.
